eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 17 · Index Tuning in Depth

code:
SELECT OBJECT_NAME(s.object_id) AS TableName,
       i.name AS IndexName,
       s.user_seeks, s.user_scans,
       s.user_lookups, s.user_updates
FROM sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats AS s
JOIN sys.indexes AS i
    ON s.object_id = i.object_id
   AND s.index_id = i.index_id
WHERE s.database_id = DB_ID()
ORDER BY s.user_seeks + s.user_scans
       + s.user_lookups DESC;
caption: Counters reset on service restart — "since restart," not all time.

code:
Measure   sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats
Identify  the specific gap (unused / missing / lookup-heavy)
Change    ONE index — add, widen, or drop
Verify    re-run the target query, check the actual plan,
          re-check usage stats after real traffic
caption: One change per iteration — never a batch.
